relations: If the central hub is struck, the radiating pink, yellow, and green domino chains will fall sequentially outward.
The black domino curve connects near the center; triggering the start causes a wave to travel along the path.
The yellow loop stands near the black path; a push causes the chain to topple continuously around the circle.
If an object rolls down the blue slide, it will transfer to the green track and trigger the dominoes.
